Return the answers of the two questions in a list. For example, if you think the answer is no and Riesz representation theorem, then return [0,2].

A. [0, 2]
B. [0, 3]
C. [1, 3]
D. [0, 1]
E. [1, 1]
F. [1, 0]
G. [1, 2]
H. [0, 4]
I. [1, 4]
J. [0, 0]

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
